jobs.title: Global Air Logistics Vertical Implementation Manager (m/f/d) - Aerospace/Defence
jobs.description:
It's more than a job

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

‎

As a Global Air Logistics Vertical Implementation Manager (m/f/d), you will play a crucial role in driving project success and contributing to the growth and efficiency of our organization. Your ability to lead, collaborate, and deliver results will be essential in achieving our strategic objectives and exceeding client expectations. The position can be filled on any Kuehne+Nagel location in the EMEA region.

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Global Air Logistics Vertical Implementation Manager (m/f/d) to lead and oversee complex global customer implementation projects and programs from initiation to successful stabilization within a defined business vertical. As part of the vertical PMO, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects on time, within scope, and within budget. You will collaborate with the related vertical leadership teams on the Sales side and the Business Unit Air Logistics side to develop vertical related strategic goals and best practice to continuously meet the market requirements and conditions of our customers. This role requires at least 5 years of experience in leading/driving large, complex projects and/or programs through complete project Life-cycle, preferably on an international basis and a solid operational background in Air Logistics.

How you create impact

Project Planning and Initiation: Lead project definition, scope, and objectives by collaborating with stakeholders. Create detailed plans, including timelines, resource and risk management
Project Execution and Control: Guide teams, ensuring alignment with goals. Monitor progress, address deviations, and maintain proactive issue resolution
Resource Management: Allocate and secure resources, collaborating with functional managers for expertise and success
Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships, communicate status, be transparent and highlight opportunities effectively
Quality Assurance: Ensure deliverables meet Kuehne+Nagel and ISO 21205 standards, conduct evaluations, and suggest and implement improvements
Competence & Strategy: Collaborate closely with the stakeholders of the assigned PMO vertical within the Sales and Business Unit Air Logistics organization to develop and lead strategic internal projects to further grow the success of vertical specific implementation management
Risk & Change Management: Identify and mitigate risks, manage scope changes professionally for successful integration
Mentoring/Supervision: Serve as a patient mentor, coaching, sharing best practices, fostering learning, and guiding junior managers on the assigned vertical requirements

What we would like you to bring

Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration or a related field
Min. 5 years of proven experience as a Project Manager and/or Program Manager, with a track record of successfully delivering complex global projects in the assigned business vertical
Strong understanding of Air Logistics operation and processes
Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide cross-functional teams
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
Proficiency in project management tools and software
Project Management Professional (PMP, PMI, Prince2) or equivalent certification is a plus

What's in it for you

At Kuehne+Nagel, you get to grow your expertise, shape processes and deliver innovative solutions. We are continuously building our local and global network and our product portfolio, creating career opportunities in different fields of work worldwide. As a leader in the logistics industry, we provide a collaborative and IT-driven environment where you will work with motivated and customer-centric colleagues across the world. We look forward to receiving your comprehensive online application.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

Excellent communication skills and advanced English proficiency (both written and spoken)

jobs.description:
Job Title: Product Owner & Senior Program Analyst

Zeiders is an industry leader in military and family support. Our company's reputation is based on providing top quality service with exceptional, dedicated employees. This approach has earned client confidence and repeat business from satisfied customers. Located in Woodbridge, VA, Zeiders’ employees support clients worldwide in behavioral health, military family resiliency, work-life education programs, and related services. We seek individuals with strong passion for what we do and our commitment to quality service.

Summary

Works under general direction of senior level management. Manages and mentors project leads and/or technical staff. Collaborates on key decisions and informs leadership and management of technical implications/requirements. Ensures processes and functions are completed and meet the stakeholder’s vision.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Serve as the functional liaison between Federal Agency stakeholders and Agile delivery teams supporting a cloud-hosted enterprise digital services platform
Translate mission needs, operational workflows, and stakeholder input into actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlog items
Collaborate with engineering, UX, data, and operations teams to ensure requirements are clearly defined and aligned with technical delivery plans
Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning support, and coordination of development priorities with program leadership
Support user experience improvements by collecting stakeholder feedback, analyzing platform usage patterns, and identifying opportunities to improve digital services
Participate in testing and validation activities to ensure delivered capabilities meet functional requirements and stakeholder expectations
Coordinate with program leadership to ensure development priorities align with mission objectives and operational needs

Supervisory Responsibilities

Manage and mentor project leads and/or technical staff.
Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
Eight (8) or more years of experience supporting federal IT programs, enterprise digital platforms, or mission applications
Minimum of four (4) years of experience in personnel management, matrixed team leadership, or project/program management involving coordination and oversight of work across geographically dispersed teams.
Demonstrated experience gathering and translating stakeholder requirements into user stories, functional specifications, or technical requirements
Experience working within Agile delivery environments and supporting backlog management and sprint planning activities
Experience supporting testing and validation activities including user acceptance testing or requirements verification
Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to bridge business needs and technical implementation.
Ability to coordinate across technical teams, program leadership, and stakeholders to ensure clear understanding of requirements and priorities

Preferred Qualifications

Certified Scrum Product Owner certification or similar Agile product management credential
Experience supporting federal digital services platforms or user-facing web applications
Familiarity with DevSecOps delivery environments and Agile development tools
Experience supporting requirements traceability and backlog management using modern project tracking tools
Experience supporting programs involving multiple stakeholder organizations or distributed user communities
Military spouse

Other Requirements

Ability to successfully complete a pre-employment and government background investigation to include FBI fingerprints.
This position requires access to U.S. Government facilities and systems. U.S. Citizenship, a valid driver's license, transportation, and auto insurance are required.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations;
Interpersonal Skills - Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Maintains confidentiality; Listens to others without interrupting; Keeps emotions under control; Remains open to others' ideas and tries new things.
Leadership - Exhibits confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well; effectively influences actions and opinions of others; Accepts feedback from others; Resolves conflict: Gives appropriate recognition to others.
Managing People: Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Maintains consistent availability to support staff needs; Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus in others; Improves processes, products and services. Continually works to improve supervisory skills. 
Change Management - Develops workable implementation plans; Communicates changes effectively; Builds commitment and overcomes resistance; Prepares and supports those affected by change; Monitors transition and evaluates results.
Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.
Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
Innovation - Displays original thinking and creativity; Meets challenges with resourcefulness; Generates suggestions for improving work; Develops innovative approaches and ideas; Presents ideas and information in a manner that gets others' attention.
Project Management - Develops project plans; Coordinates projects. Communicates changes and progress. Completes projects on time and on budget. Manages project team activities.
Ability to solve complex technical, managerial, or operational problems and evaluate options based on relevant information, resources, well-rounded experience, and knowledge.

jobs.title: Principal Applied Threat Intelligence Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate.

Microsoft Security Research is at the front line of defending Microsoft customers and the broader ecosystem against the world's most sophisticated threat actors. Our Applied Threat Intelligence team tracks the threat landscape and the threat actors that target our customers; where they have been, where they are today, and predict where they will be tomorrow. We partner deeply across Microsoft Threat Intelligence, product engineering, and research to ensure our customers stay ahead of threats.

Responsibilities

Manage a team of Applied Threat Intelligence analysts to lead with AI to understand the threat landscape and the latest attacker tradecraft.
Track threat actors, including financially motivated threat actors; their infrastructure, their targets, and their shifting techniques, tactics, and procedures.
Translate complex technical findings into clear, prescriptive guidance for security operations teams, executives, and the broader defender community.
Partner with product, research, marketing, and communications teams to ensure high-quality intelligence experiences through Microsoft's customer-facing surfaces and managed services (Agentic Security, Defender XDR, Defender Experts, Sentinel, blogs, briefings).
Build and refine the pipelines, tooling, and workflows that allow Microsoft to stream insightful cyber threat intelligence to customers machine speed.
Represent Microsoft Threat Intelligence in customer briefings, industry conferences, and cross-industry working groups.
Mentor analysts and contribute to tradecraft, analytic standards, and team-wide knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 3+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.

○ OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 4+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.

○ OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 6+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.

○ OR equivalent experience.

1+ year(s) people management experience.

Other Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check

This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
This position requires verification of U.S. citizenship due to citizenship‑based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports United States federal, state, and/or local government agency customers and is subject to certain citizenship‑based restrictions where required or permitted by applicable law. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified via a valid passport.

Preferred Qualifications

Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 5+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.

○ OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 8+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.

○ OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 12+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.

○ OR equivalent experience.

3+ years people management and/or informal/indirect team leadership experience.
10+ years of experience in cyber threat intelligence, threat hunting, incident response, or a closely related security discipline.
Attribution experience creating threat groups, assessing connections between established threat groups, and communicating attribution assessments to internal stakeholders and customers in a timely manner.
Demonstrated experience producing finished threat intelligence reporting for technical and/or executive audiences.
Working experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR (or directly comparable SIEM/XDR platforms).
Understanding of adversary tradecraft, the cyber kill chain, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, and structured analytic techniques.
Written and verbal communication skills, with a portfolio of public or customer-facing intelligence writing.
Experience tracking and defending against financially motivated threat actors.
Experience with endpoint, cloud, network, and identity-based attacks and datasets.
Experience with AI tools and large language models, building agents and skills for information security applications and pipelines.
Comprehensive OS security/internals knowledge.
Understanding of network protocols and analytical experience with network infrastructure data & telemetry.
Reverse-engineering with static and behavioral binary analysis experience.
Functional understanding of common threat analysis models such as the Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain, and MITRE ATT&CK.
Programming or scripting background (Python, PowerShell, C#, C++, etc.)

#MSecR #MSSecurity

Security Research M5 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $142,800 - $274,800 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $188,000 - $304,200 per year.

About The Role

The Business Data Analyst turns operational and product data into reliable reporting, actionable insights, and decision-ready analysis. The role works across SQL-based data warehouses, dbt models, and BI tools to define metrics, investigate performance changes, and improve visibility into business health.

The analyst partners with product, operations, finance, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous questions into structured analyses and repeatable dashboards. Validate data quality across source systems and transformation layers; investigate discrepancies and coordinate fixes with data engineering

Experience using Python or a comparable scripting language for analysis, data validation, or workflow automation
Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, business, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
Bonus: Experience with Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Amplitude, Segment, experimentation analysis, forecasting, or product-led technology environments

jobs.title: Vineyard Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Winemaking in some major regions of the world can be an ‘industrial’ undertaking, but for us here at Iconic Wineries of British Columbia, every decision in the vineyard has a direct impact on the quality of what ultimately ends up in the bottle.

Exceptional vineyards require more than great farming practices. They require clear insights, strong operational discipline, and the ability to understand the story behind the data.

Our vineyards generate vast amounts of information every season, from labour and productivity metrics to purchasing activity, operational costs, vineyard performance trends, and planning data. The opportunity is no longer collecting data. It is transforming that information into meaningful insights that help our teams make better decisions.

The Role

As our Vineyard Business Analyst
, you will play a critical role in helping us better understand, measure, and optimize the performance of our vineyard operations. Sitting at the intersection of data, operations, finance, and viticulture, you will transform complex operational information into actionable insights that improve productivity, strengthen cost visibility, and support decision-making across our vineyards. This is a highly collaborative role that combines business analysis, operational reporting, procurement support, and data visualization. You will work closely with Vineyard Managers, operational leaders, and finance partners to uncover trends, identify opportunities, and build reporting tools that provide clarity across vineyard operations. More than a reporting role, this is an opportunity to bring a fresh perspective, challenge assumptions with data, and help shape how vineyard performance is measured and managed for years to come.

Productivity & Performance Analytics

Measure and monitor vineyard productivity, labour efficiency, and operational performance across activities, blocks, sites, and seasons.
Analyze key operational metrics including hours per acre, cost per activity, labour utilization, and year-over-year performance trends.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Translate complex operational data into practical recommendations that vineyard leadership can act on.
Support annual planning processes through productivity benchmarking, workforce analysis, and operational forecasting.
Develop meaningful performance indicators that help leaders understand operational effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

Data Visualization & Reporting

Design and maintain dashboards and reporting tools that provide visibility into vineyard performance and operational health.
Transform data from multiple operational systems into meaningful business insights.
Develop reporting frameworks that allow teams to proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Present data in a clear and compelling way, helping stakeholders understand the story behind the numbers.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accessibility across vineyard reporting processes.
Create visualizations that simplify complex datasets and support informed decision-making at all levels of the organization.

Financial Analysis, Procurement & Cost Visibility

Support procurement and purchasing activities by validating invoices and ensuring alignment to approved budgets and plans.
Monitor vineyard operating costs and spending trends to improve financial visibility across the organization.
Partner with Finance and operational teams to improve cost reporting and forecasting accuracy.
Identify potential productivity or cost-related risks before they become larger operational challenges.
Maintain disciplined documentation and reporting standards that support planning, budgeting, and operational decision-making.
Help establish stronger cost controls and spending transparency across vineyard operations.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Partner closely with Vineyard Managers, operational leaders, finance teams, vendors, and stakeholders across the business.
Build trusted relationships while introducing new ways of measuring and evaluating operational performance.
Support the development of data-driven processes that improve consistency and operational discipline across vineyard operations.
Bring curiosity, fresh thinking, and a continuous improvement mindset to help evolve how work gets done.
Contribute to a culture where decisions are informed by data, insight, and transparency.
Act as a bridge between operational teams and data, ensuring insights translate into meaningful action.

Who You Are

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Supply Chain, Agriculture, or a related discipline.
2+ years of experience in business analysis, operational analytics, financial analysis, supply chain, procurement, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced Excel skills with strong capabilities in data manipulation, reporting, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to transform data into actionable recommendations.
Comfortable working with both operational and financial datasets in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders through data and insights.
Experience in agriculture, wine, food manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, or operational environments is considered an asset, but not required.
Naturally curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by solving problems and improving processes.
Able to translate complex information into simple, practical business recommendations.

What's In It For You

A rare opportunity to help build and shape how vineyard performance is measured across one of Canada's most respected premium wine organizations.
Visible impact across vineyard operations, influencing planning, budgeting, productivity improvement, and operational decision-making.
Exposure to vineyard operations, finance, procurement, business analytics, and strategic planning in one highly collaborative role.
The opportunity to create reporting tools and processes that become foundational to how our teams operate.
A role where your insights directly influence business decisions rather than sit in a report.
Partnership with experienced vineyard, finance, and operational leaders who value curiosity, fresh thinking, and continuous improvement.
The ability to bring a fresh lens, challenge legacy processes, and make a measurable impact on how the business operates.
Opportunity to grow your scope and influence as our vineyard analytics and reporting capabilities continue to evolve.

Why Join Us?

Iconic Wineries of British Columbia is committed to hiring, engaging, and growing qualified, talented, and motivated team members at every level of our organization. jobs.title: First Nations/Inuit/Métis Candidates: Cybersecurity, Application Security Analyst/Consultant -R8dius
jobs.description:
Job Type:
Permanent Work Model:
Hybrid Reference code:
134177 Primary Location:
Toronto, ON All Available Locations:
Toronto, ON; Burlington, ON; Calgary, AB; Edmonton, AB; Fredericton, NB; Halifax, NS; Kitchener, ON; Moncton, NB; Ottawa, ON; Regina, SK; Saint John, NB; Saskatoon, SK; St. John's, NL; Vancouver, BC; Victoria, BC; Winnipeg, MB

Our Purpose

R8dius is an Indigenous majority-owned professional services, technology implementation and managed services business. We are united by the goal of forging a new path for all of us to walk and prosper together.

It’s a rare thing when you get to help build the future. But that’s every day at R8dius. We’re working to turn R8dius into a meeting place, enabled by our shared purpose, where we can learn and grow together.

Our purpose is to “Widen the Circle”, or in other words, to expand the horizons of opportunity and prosperity so that Indigenous Peoples can be leaders in the professional services space. We are compelled to find solutions to challenging problems that drive our people, our company, and our clients forward.

By living our Purpose, together we will make an impact that matters.

Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching
Be encouraged to deepen your technical skills…whatever those may be.
Partner with diverse clients to solve their most complex problems
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Work in an agile work environment where work is what you do not where you do it

What will your typical day look like?

You will support the delivery of Application Security engagements across leading enterprise platforms, including Workday, Oracle, SAP, SuccessFactors, and Salesforce. Working alongside experienced practitioners, you will help clients strengthen their security posture by assessing application security risks, evaluating configurations and access controls, and supporting the delivery of practical, risk-based recommendations.

You will contribute to high-quality client service through collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to delivering exceptional results. In addition to client engagements, you will support practice development initiatives, thought leadership activities, and the growth of R8dius’ Application Security capabilities.

You will have the following responsibilities:

Support the delivery of application security assessments, reviews, and advisory engagements across cloud-based enterprise applications, including Workday, Oracle, SAP, SuccessFactors, and Salesforce.
Assess application security risks, access management processes, segregation of duties (SoD) conflicts, and configuration-related security concerns, and contribute to remediation recommendations.
Collaborate with clients and project teams to design and enhance application security, governance, and access control frameworks.
Analyze information, document findings, and develop clear, concise reports and presentations for both technical and business audiences.
Support security role design, user access management, governance, and compliance initiatives across enterprise applications.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and colleagues through proactive communication, collaboration, and professionalism.
Continuously expand your knowledge of application security, identity and access management, emerging technologies, and industry-leading practices to support client needs and enhance project delivery.

About The Team

R8dius’ Cyber Application Security team helps organizations protect their most critical business applications and data. We work with clients across a variety of industries to identify security risks, strengthen governance, and enhance security capabilities across leading enterprise platforms, including Workday, Oracle, SAP, SuccessFactors, and Salesforce.

Our team combines expertise in Application Security, GRC Access Controls, Business Process Controls, and Cloud Security to help clients address complex security and compliance challenges while enabling secure digital transformation.

As part of this team, you will collaborate with experienced practitioners across Canada, contribute to impactful client engagements, and support the development of innovative security solutions and thought leadership. You'll have the opportunity to grow your technical and consulting skills while helping organizations build secure and resilient business operations.

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

As an Analyst
,

You are curious, motivated, and passionate about cybersecurity, with a desire to build your career in application security and enterprise technology. You enjoy solving complex problems, collaborating with others, and continuously learning in a fast-paced consulting environment.

You bring:

Self-identifies as First Nations (Status or Non-Status), Inuit, or Métis in Canada.
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, Business Technology Management, or a related field.
Foundational knowledge of cybersecurity and application security principles, including identity and access management, role-based security, access controls, and risk management concepts.
Familiarity with enterprise applications such as Oracle, SAP, Workday, SuccessFactors, Salesforce, or similar platforms is an asset.
An understanding of governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) concepts, including Segregation of Duties (SoD), user access management, and security governance, or a strong willingness to learn.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess information and develop practical recommendations.
Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
A collaborative mindset, commitment to delivering high-quality work, and enthusiasm for continuous learning and professional growth.
Experience using AI-enabled tools to enhance research, analysis, and documentation is considered an asset.

Nice to have:

Exposure to GRC Access Controls, IAM, SoD analysis, application security assessments, or cloud security concepts.
Progress toward security or cloud certifications such as Security+, SC-900, AZ-900, AWS Cloud Practitioner, or similar credentials.

As a Consultant
,

You are passionate about application security and helping organizations strengthen the security of their critical business applications. You combine technical knowledge with consulting skills to deliver practical, risk-based solutions that help clients address security, compliance, and governance challenges.

You bring:

Self-identifies as First Nations (Status or Non-Status), Inuit, or Métis in Canada.
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, Business Technology Management, or a related field.
2-5 years of experience in Application Security, Identity and Access Management (IAM), GRC Access Controls, or a related cybersecurity discipline.
Experience assessing security risks and controls within enterprise applications such as Oracle, SAP, Workday, SuccessFactors, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of application security governance, user access management, role design, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and security and compliance leading practices.
Experience supporting application security assessments, access control reviews, security remediation efforts, or advisory engagements.
Familiarity with enterprise security frameworks, regulatory requirements, and governance processes.
Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) and associated security considerations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate security risks and recommendations to business and technical stakeholders.
The ability to manage competing priorities while delivering high-quality work in a client-facing environment.
Strong relationship-building skills, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to continuous professional development.
Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency in research, analysis, and documentation.

Nice to have:

Experience with GRC Access Controls, SoD analysis, user access reviews, security role design, or ERP security implementations.
Exposure to business process controls, cloud security, or compliance programs.
Relevant certifications such as Security+, SC-100, AZ-500, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, SAP Security, Oracle Security, or equivalent certifications in progress.

Total Rewards

The salary range is $50,000 - $90,000 for Analysts and $58,000 - $102,000 for Consultants , and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. R8dius is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. Some representative examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, personal/wellness days, vacation, flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Reasons to believe in R8dius are reasons to believe in the future.

We are Indigenous majority-owned.

The brighter future we seek must ensure Indigenous knowledge is the beacon that guides this business forward.

We create new paths.

Combining Indigenous knowledge and worldviews with imaginative solutions and advanced technologies will illuminate new opportunities for individuals, and new

forms of progress for our communities.

We are a national network.

R8dius is a network comprised of Indigenous and Deloitte’s service capabilities. We share values, a focus on long-term change, and the belief that a purpose-led organization can make an impact for all.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

R8dius is committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where are team members and clients feel like they belong.

Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI.

We seek applicants with a range of skills and abilities. We are committed to providing a diverse candidate experience. If you require accommodations, we encourage you to connect with us at accessiblecareers@deloitte.ca if you require an accommodation. All other inquires can be sent to info@R8dius.ca.

We acknowledge that R8dius operates on traditional, treaty, and unceded territories in what is now known as Canada. We recognize that Indigenous Peoples have been the caretakers of this land since time immemorial, nurturing its resources and preserving its natural beauty. We acknowledge this land is still home to many First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Peoples, who continue to maintain their deep connection to the land and its sacred teachings. We humbly acknowledge that we are all Treaty people, and we commit to fostering a new relationship of respect, collaboration, and stewardship.

jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Role

As a Data Analyst at NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions, you will serve as the primary technical and analytical support for our real-time and memory-based drilling services. Acting as a key focal point across up to three rigs at a time, you will monitor operations, interpret complex downhole datasets, and provide timely recommendations that enhance drilling performance, manage risk, and protect wellbore integrity.

You will support Project Managers as an in-house drilling advisor, own critical analytical workflows (from optimization reporting to post-well reviews), and act as a technical escalation point for both internal teams and clients. This role combines deep drilling domain knowledge with strong analytical skills and offers the opportunity to contribute directly to new software solutions, advanced tools, and industry-leading technical publications.

About The Company

NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions is a business group within the NOV Energy Products and Services segment, specializing in drilling automation and optimization through the use of real-time downhole data. By deploying Wired Drill Pipe (WDP) technology and Along-String Measurement (ASM) tools, we enable the transmission of high-density, low-latency data from downhole systems to surface teams. This includes key metrics such as temperature, pressure, rotation, and vibration data, which contribute to smarter, safer, and more efficient drilling operations. As demand grows, we continue to expand our operations and analytics teams to drive innovation and excellence for our customers.

What We Offer

Joining National Oilwell Varco means becoming part of a dynamic, international team committed to delivering outstanding results. We provide:

Challenging Assignments: Work on complex, high-impact drilling and well construction projects where advanced analytics directly influence operational decisions.
Career Development: Access strong technical career paths, mentoring, and opportunities to grow as a Data Analyst across drilling dynamics, data analytics, and digital solutions.
Collaborative Atmosphere: Thrive in an open and informal work environment where teamwork, innovation, and personal responsibility are valued.
Global Exposure: Collaborate with world-class clients, internal experts, and third-party partners on regional and global projects.

At NOV, your contributions make a difference. We look forward to welcoming motivated individuals ready to take their careers to the next level.

Why Join Our Global Family

We are a purpose-driven company on a mission to empower the global energy industry. At NOV, we foster a culture of inclusion where every employee is valued for their unique background, experiences, and perspectives. We believe in recognizing talent and providing opportunities for growth, and we are committed to making a positive impact on the communities where we live and work.

If you are passionate about drilling data, optimization, and technical excellence—and want your work to directly shape safer, more efficient operations for our customers—we would be excited to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the main focal point for technical and analytical support across assigned rigs.
Provide daily technical oversight for real-time operations and tool performance.
Generate optimization reports with key events, mitigations, and recommendations.
Deliver operational intervention support on drilling dynamics, pressure management, and wellbore integrity.
Conduct BHA and operational design reviews, trajectory advice, and scope-of-work reviews.
Perform detailed performance and failure analysis using high-frequency memory data.
Support field testing and rollout of new tools, software, and technical changes.
Own the peer review process for technical service delivery and reporting.
Develop and deliver internal and customer technical training; mentor senior operations staff.
Collaborate with client engineering and subsurface teams and contribute to technical publications.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Skills

Degree in Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
Preferably 3-5 years’ experience in drilling operations, including significant exposure to DD/LWD and drilling optimization, or equivalent combination of field and analytical experience.
Strong expertise in drilling dynamics, BHA design, trajectory management, and well integrity concepts.
Demonstrated experience in performance analysis, high-frequency data interpretation, and failure investigation.
Proven ability to translate complex datasets into clear operational recommendations and client-ready reports.
Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams (operations, subsurface, engineering, quality, and software).
Comfortable presenting technical findings to internal stakeholders, clients, and at industry forums; experience authoring technical papers is an advantage.
Proficient in standard data analysis and visualization tools; experience with advanced analytics, scripting, or programming languages is a plus.
Fluent in English, both written and verbal; additional languages are an asset.

About Us

Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.

We Power the Industry that Powers the World

Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.

Global Family

We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.

Purposeful Innovation

Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.

Service Above All

This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

About The Team

Corporate

Our family of companies is supported by our global Corporate teams, providing expert knowledge from functions including Human Resources, Information Technology, Compliance, Finance, QHSE, Marketing and Legal centers of expertise. We are structured to provide guidance and service above all to all our business operations.

Partner with clients to understand business goals, document requirements, and translate them into clear user stories and functional specifications.

Collaborate closely with Salesforce configurators, developers, and project managers to ensure requirements are accurately understood and delivered.

3-5 years of experience in a Salesforce consulting firm or professional services environment, supporting Salesforce implementation projects in a Business Analyst role.

Experience facilitating requirements-gathering sessions and translating business needs into user stories, process flows, and functional documentation.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and project management practices.
The ability to work within a team environment, supported by strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Well-organized, results-driven, and the ability to work comfortably in a fast-paced consulting environment with multiple client engagements.
Excellent organizational, verbal, presentation/facilitation, and written communication skills.
Willingness to travel for client and team engagements as needed.
Comfort with AI: Demonstrated ability to responsibly explore and adopt firm-approved AI tools to enhance productivity and innovation.
Continuous Learning Mindset: Openness to learning and applying emerging technologies, including AI and automation, in alignment with firm policies and client standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Administrator, Business Analyst) are a plus but not required.
Experience in a consulting or professional services environment is required.

JOB TITLE:
PART-TIME INTERIM EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR & PROJECT COORDINATOR

BRAINTREE RANDOLPH EMERGENCY COMMUNICATION CENTER (BRECC)

LOCATION:
DISPATCH CENTER

UNION:
NON-UNION

DATE AVAILABLE:
ASAP

SALARY:
$65.00 PER HOUR UP TO 19 HOURS PER WEEK

The Town of Braintree, on behalf of the Braintree-Randolph Emergency Communications Center (BRECC), seeks an experienced leader to serve as its Part-Time Interim Executive Director & Project Coordinator. The BRECC is a newly established regional district made up of the Towns of Braintree and Randolph for purpose of providing regional dispatch.

The position works under the direction of the Braintree Mayor, as a Town of Braintree employee. The Interim Executive Director & Project Coordinator will oversee all aspects of the Dispatch Center design operations and facility, managing the regional 911 and public safety dispatch center, administering operational budgets, researching and proposing policies and procedures for the Operational Committee, hiring, evaluating and reviewing personnel, coordinating the procurement and maintenance of dispatch center technology and equipment, and other dispatch center management.

The Town is currently in the design development process for the Dispatch Center building. The Interim Executive Director & Project Coordinator will work with the district representatives to oversee the project, determine center needs, including technology, furniture and layout, and develop policies to meet the ongoing and transitional needs of the participating communities.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate for this role will be looking to join a team that values professionalism, accountability, integrity and responsiveness. Qualifications include the following:

3+ years of relevant experience; a bachelor’s degree is preferred.
Education and experience must be in the fields of communications and public safety operations, criminal justice, Fire Rescue, Emergency Medical Services, homeland security, emergency management, safety management, and related fields.
Working knowledge of Fire, Police and EMS communications.
Working knowledge of the current 911 system
Valid driver’s license
Must be able to satisfactorily undergo a Police records check
Preference will be given to applicants who are certified COML or COM/T with multi jurisdiction-interoperability experience at the Federal, State and local government level.
Familiarity with industry standards, APCO, NFPA, IAFC/IMSA frequency coordination.
Excellence in organizational management with the ability to coach staff, vendors, and contractors.
Develop high-performance teams, set and achieve objectives, and manage a budget.

Responsibilties

Please see attached job description for complete details.

POSTING DATES: September 21, 2026 – until filled

Salary commensurate with qualifications and experience. This posting is not meant to be inclusive of all job duties or qualification requirements; please visit the Town of Braintree for a complete job description.

To apply, send resume and cover letter in a single PDF via email with the subject line BRECC Interim Executive Director & Project Coordinator to jobs@braintreema.gov.

The Town of Braintree is an equal opportunity employer and recruits and hires qualified candidates without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status. The Town of Braintree seeks a workforce that reflects the diversity of its community, and all are encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
Project Manager - Commercial Construction

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead commercial construction projects including apartments, resorts, and other large-scale developments. The Project Manager will oversee project delivery from preconstruction through closeout, ensuring safety, quality, schedule, and budget targets are met. This role requires strong leadership, excellent communication with clients and subcontractors, and familiarity with OSHPD requirements for healthcare-related scopes where applicable.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, coordinate, and manage all phases of commercial construction projects from preconstruction to closeout.
Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and cash flow forecasts; track progress and implement corrective actions to meet milestones.
Coordinate and manage subcontractor bidding, selection, contracts, and performance; negotiate change orders and resolve disputes.
Ensure compliance with contract documents, building codes, safety regulations, and OSHPD requirements when applicable.
Lead project meetings with owners, design teams, inspectors, and subcontractors; provide regular status reports and risk assessments to stakeholders.
Oversee quality control and assurance programs, conduct site inspections, and ensure punch list items are completed before turnover.
Manage procurement of materials and equipment, review submittals, and maintain accurate project documentation and as-built records.
Mentor and supervise assistant project managers, superintendents, and project staff; foster a collaborative, safety-first culture.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
Minimum 7 years experience managing commercial construction projects, including apartments and resort developments.
Proven track record as a Project Manager with responsibility for budget, schedule, and quality control.
Experience with OSHPD processes and documentation for healthcare or hospital projects is highly desirable.
Strong knowledge of construction means and methods, building codes, safety regulations, and contract administration.
Excellent leadership, negotiation, and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and complex schedules.
Proficiency with construction management software (Procore, MS Project, Primavera, or similar) and Microsoft Office.
Relevant certifications (PMP, CCM, LEED AP) and strong references from prior commercial construction projects are a plus.

Benefits

- Competitive base + bonus
- Full Medical, life insurance etc.
- 401K with company match
- PTO + Vacation + Sick time

jobs.title: Civil Design Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
Civil Assistant Project Manager

Position Overview

We are seeking a proactive Civil Assistant Project Manager to support project delivery for land development projects across residential, commercial and industrial sectors. The successful candidate will assist project managers in planning, coordinating and executing civil engineering design and construction activities, with a focus on site grading, drainage and stormwater management. This role requires a strong civil engineering background, hands-on experience in land development, and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams, clients and regulatory agencies to deliver projects on time and on budget.

Key Responsibilities

Support project managers in the planning, design, permitting and construction phases of land development projects (residential, commercial, industrial).
Prepare and review civil engineering design documents, calculations and technical reports related to grading, drainage, stormwater management, erosion and sediment control, and earthwork analysis.
Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets and scope tracking; assist with cost estimating and change order documentation.
Coordinate with clients, contractors, regulatory agencies and internal teams to obtain permits, resolve design issues and ensure compliance with zoning and local regulations.
Perform site visits and construction observations to verify compliance with approved plans and to document site conditions and progress.
Assist with QA/QC reviews of drawings and deliverables; ensure consistency and technical accuracy across project documentation.
Use MicroStation and/or  Civil3D, AutoCAD to produce and edit site plans, grading plans, utility plans and construction details.
Support preparation of bid packages, subcontractor coordination and evaluation of contractor submittals.
Mentor junior engineers and technical staff; delegate tasks and review work to promote professional development and maintain project quality.
Contribute to business development activities including proposal preparation, scope development and client presentations.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering required.
5+ years of relevant experience in land development and civil/site engineering.
Proven experience with site design, grading, drainage and stormwater management.
Strong understanding of zoning, permitting processes and local regulatory requirements for land development projects.
Proficiency with MicroStation and/or AutoCAD/Civil3D is highly desirable.
Experience with erosion and sediment control practices, earthwork analysis and spillway design is a plus.
Professional Engineer (PE) license, or demonstrated progression to obtaining (ex. EIT)
Demonstrated project coordination skills including schedule and budget tracking, client communication and subconsultant management.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical reports and present to clients and agencies.

Vacation/PTO - 17 days PTO, 9 paid holidays

Dental - Company pays at least 85% of insurance premium

jobs.description:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter . Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of War, Interagency Division (JOID) provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

The Critical Infrastructure Group (CIG) within JOID provides technical, programmatic, and analytical support to customers with missions in national security, including the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Health and Human Services (HHS), and the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). The Group brings technical and operational expertise in fields such as countering weapons of mass destruction, critical infrastructure protection, emergency response, and transportation safety.

We have a future need for an Operations Research Analyst to assist with systems engineering (SE) and testing and evaluation (T&E) programs in support of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). The primary place of performance will be at SPA Headquarters in Alexandria, VA with regular visits to customer sites in VA and DC.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Operations Research Analyst will review and comment on revisions of program T&E documents and provide the Government advice. Support multiple DHS acquisition programs, especially in Reliability, Cyber Resilience, AI, and Human Systems Integration. Advise the Government to ensure acquisition T&E efforts properly apply standard T&E practices. Provide guidance, recommendations, mentoring, and reviews for TEMPs, Operational Assessment/Test Plans and Reports, and Letters of Assessment. Contribute expertise to T&E training curriculum development. Research government and industry sources to identify and recommend relevant T&E tools, plans, and procedures in specialty areas.

Qualifications

Required:

Master's degree and 10 years of relevant experience and expertise in Reliability, Cyber Resilience, AI, and/or Human Systems Integration.
DHS T&E Level 3 Certification, DAWIA T&E Practitioner Level 2/3, and/or CTEP (Certified Test and Evaluation Professional).
Proven ability to communicate effectively, both in written and verbal formats, with diverse stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
Active Secret clearance with ability to obtain DHS Suitability.

Desired

Experience in providing assistance to program planning and oversight, exercise, development, execution and evaluation; system level analysis; system integration support inclusive of understanding of threats and vulnerability; technical assessment & evaluation to support and complement the Government’s technical experts in applying both acquisition efforts and RDT&E towards accomplishing the DHS mission.
Prior experience supporting DHS programs.
Active DHS Suitability.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Roads)
jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A Little More About Your Role…

WSP are seeking an enthusiastic and talented Project Manager to join the Roads team based in London & South East

Skills

Your role will be at the heart of our high performing team, using your project management skills and expertise to help us continue to successfully deliver projects effectively and efficiently for our clients. You can expect your role to involve:

Managing the delivery of highways projects for public and private sector clients across the UK, through planning, design and construction stages.
Ensuring compliance with quality management systems, and drive efficiencies throughout project execution.
You will be supported by a team of experienced and developing technical staff of various grades, to whom you will be expected to provide guidance and support as appropriate.
Contribute to the development of the team’s internal knowledge base. Mentors and upskills junior staff helping them develop professionally and progress towards professional qualifications.
Work with limited supervision to plan, execute, monitor and control projects as well as effectively managing project change.
Undertake contract management and administration under a range of framework and standalone contracts.
Your clients will range from local authorities in the South East and London area, national infrastructure agencies and private developers in a diverse range of sectors.
Your team will comprise of Engineers in the UK supported by remote resources in India – this worldwide representation brings a diverse culture to your team.
Being active on several varied multi-disciplinary project/client accounts at any given time.
Work collaboratively with clients, key stakeholders and internal teams, as necessary to deliver the schemes/projects.

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Professional qualification in project management, and/or an engineering discipline.
Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Maths (STEM)
Undertaken NEC accreditation and attained the necessary technical and practical skills to lead and administer NEC Contracts.
Membership of professional institutions such as: Association for Project Management (APM), Project Management Institute (PMI), Royal Institute of Chartered Surveyors (MRICS) or Member of Institute of Civil Engineers (MICE).
A background in highway/linear infrastructure projects would be beneficial, but our focus is upon your ability and desire to develop your project management career to its full potential and demonstrate agility and transferability.
Demonstrate competence in stakeholder management, risk, planning/scheduling, and commercial management.
Proficiency in use of project management tools and software.
Experience of complying with Designers Duties under CDM regulations.

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

Health & Wellbeing

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

Flex your time

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

#WeAreWSP

Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.

jobs.title: Senior Security Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

We're looking for an experienced and driven Senior Security Technical Program Manager to join Snap's Security Programs and Compliance Engineering (SPACE)
Team. This pivotal role is focused on establishing a mature, enterprise-wide cybersecurity framework essential for protecting our global user base, employees, and partners. You'll be the instrumental driver of the program for security: metrics, governance, operating cadence, cross-functional execution, and leadership accountability for security maturity outcomes.

What you’ll do:

Lead the design, build, and ongoing operation of security operations and risk programs that improve cyber maturity across core security foundations, including governance, intake, prioritization, escalation, and remediation follow-through.
Define and operationalize security KRIs, KPIs, and health metrics across key domains such as vulnerability management, incident response, detection and response effectiveness, control performance, remediation timeliness, and recurring risk themes.
Establish a consistent measurement framework, dashboarding model, and reporting taxonomy so security leaders can review trends, identify material gaps, and drive accountable action across their teams.
Prepare and present regular business reviews for security leadership that translate technical signals into clear risk narratives, decisions, priorities, and follow-up actions.
Build the operating cadence for security team leadership, including program reviews, metric reviews, escalation forums, and quarterly planning rhythms that connect strategy to execution.
Establish a common organizational framework for security team OKRs, including goal setting, dependency management, milestone tracking, evidence of progress, and end-of-quarter readouts.
Partner across Security, Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and Operations to align program priorities, resolve blockers, and ensure consistent execution of risk reduction workstreams.
Drive root-cause analysis and remediation governance for significant operational issues, ensuring lessons learned are translated into durable process, technology, or control improvements.
Create and maintain a portfolio view of security initiatives, risks, dependencies, and commitments, and use that view to support prioritization, staffing discussions, and leadership tradeoff decisions.
Define standard methods for risk intake, issue tracking, exception handling, escalation thresholds, and verified closure to improve consistency across the security organization.
Improve the rigor of security operations by identifying opportunities for workflow simplification, automation, and better decision support, reducing toil while increasing transparency and accountability.
Develop executive-ready briefing materials, scorecards, and narratives that clearly communicate program status, emerging risks, mitigation plans, and areas requiring leadership intervention.
Monitor program performance over time and recommend changes to operating models, metrics, and review mechanisms to continuously raise the maturity of security operations and risk management practices.

Knowledge, skills, & abilities:

Depth of security experience and familiarity with a broad range of information security concepts and principles
Proven experience of running critical programs within a security field
Experience working with engineers, driving large security projects that have had a proven impact
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with mastery in the ability to tailor the message to the audience
Experience influencing teams and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive security programs
Proficiency in, or a strong aptitude for, leveraging AI tools to streamline development, paired with the critical judgment to audit generated output for architectural integrity, performance bottlenecks, and security risks.
Adaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of engineering trends and modern development practices.

Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field or equivalent experience
6+ years of experience in security advisory space, technical program management or security solution delivery

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with with NIST CSF 2.0, NIS2, or ISO 27001
Experience with CISSP, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or similar certifications a plus

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

Strategic knowledge of cost control, budgeting, billing, and forecasting.
Familiarity of all aspects of building to include site work, structure, finishes, envelope, MEPS.

Advanced ability to effectively lead, manage and mentor staff.
Ability to clearly define goals, understand audiences, manage productive meetings, manage and build team morale.
Strategic communication skills. Ability to address an audience of various sizes and effectively communicate his/her message and ideas Ability to write clear and concise thoughts in a professional manner.

Strategic customer focus and the ability to work cohesively with many constituents.
Displays and attitude of ownership and responsibility.
Self-starter.
Exhibits managerial courage.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
Typically, 10 years managing complex construction projects.
Experience with exteriors and facades required.

Are you motivated by working in multidisciplinary teams and being the point of contact for our clients regarding project management? We have an exciting opportunity for you. Together with our team, you will be able to make a difference and achieve project success, both for the client and our company. Let us explore how our collaboration can lead to mutual success.

What you will do as Senior Project Manager Light Industry

Within our Industry market, we serve clients within the Food & Beverage, Pharmaceutical, Consumer Goods and Technology sectors. As a Project Manager, you are expected to deliver total success to allocated projects in green and/or brown-field manufacturing environments. You will be leading and managing multidisciplinary teams and act as the single point of contact with the client.

Responsibilities

In the current business environment, multinational clients are increasingly requesting us to develop business cases together with them in which engineering is fully integrated. These business cases subsequently are translated into conceptual design studies and master plans. As a Project Manager, you understand our client´s primary processes. You will support business development as well; hence you are expected to have a personal network of potential clients, and you have the commercial skills to develop accounts into sustainable repeating business. Your main responsibilities consist of:

Managing and leading medium/large-scale engineering construction projects in a multi stakeholder environment throughout a complete project life cycle, supporting our multinational clients to makes the best value decisions;
Developing, leading and managing the team during project development and delivery;
Initiating projects together with clients, coordinate stakeholder input, analyze and appraise production solutions, prepare project briefs and business cases and gain the necessary approvals within the client’s organization;
Overseeing all project controls: e.g., planning, cost control, project administration and contract management;
Operating in an international context and anticipating short- and medium- term travel.

Where you will work

At Haskoning, you will join an independent, employee-owned international consultancy that combines engineering, design, and consultancy services with software and technology. Our mission, "Enhancing Society Together," drives us to create a positive impact on the world.

We offer purpose-driven and challenging work in diverse international projects, leveraging our 140+ years of expertise. With over 6,800 employees in more than 25 countries, we work together to turn challenges into opportunities and make a real impact on society. We collaborate with leading clients in markets such as infrastructure, climate resilience, renewable energy, decarbonisation of industry, and sustainable mobility.

As our new Project Manager Light Industry, you will become part of the Project Management & Consultancy team. The Project Management & Consultancy team consists of highly experienced and solution-oriented project managers and consultants with extensive experience in large-scale, multidisciplinary construction projects in various sectors. Our goal is to achieve higher productivity and lower operating costs for our clients through technical optimization. Together with our clients, we place projects from a broader perspective.

Each project has its own individual challenges, be it budgets, logistics, timing, materials or people. That is why we offer a dedicated and customized approach for each project. This way, we ensure that every project comes to a successful conclusion, from initial concept to final delivery.

What you bring

As Senior Project Manager Light Industry we expect you to be a qualified professional, and project management certifications are desirable (e.g., IPMA, Prince). With your proven track record in managing medium and large-scale projects, you have built a strong, high level international network within the food & beverage, pharmaceutical, and other manufacturing sectors. An international mindset and willingness to travel short- and medium- term assignments are important in this role, which is why an international CV would be desirable.

Within this role we expect you to have excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effortlessly adjust yourself in an international and culturally diverse environment and be able to act as coach and mentor for other staff. You must be able to build and maintain a trusted advisor status at director level with clients. As an entrepreneur with strong business acumen and sound understanding of business financials with a clear market drive, a focus on clients and the client’s network recognizing profitability and revenue potential in business opportunities. You also stay aware of international standards and developments in the fields of health and safety and sustainability and actively promote these in your projects.

Furthermore, you have

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience with a technical background (civil, mechanical).
Over 8 years of experience in Project Management within the industry environment;
